public_trace_findings: All six episodes used the full additional usable time and timed out; the larger budget alone did not solve the policy problem.

decision: Reject candidate C and do not expand it. Test an official-style worked trajectory and deterministic duplicate/no-output feedback before considering a larger budget or more complex policy. Restore explicit always-print behavior and use task-relevant doc queries rather than broad app-only searches.
